checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Supplied photo remains base of square output
must.why: Same photo, 640x640, unchanged apart from the text.
'Warm hugs in a cup' is rendered on the image.
Dark brown script on light marble is clearly legible.
The text sits above the cup and covers nothing.
Nothing besides the caption was added.

faults.what: Output is only 640px, so it is low resolution for a café post.
The script lettering is slightly thin and crosses some marble veining, but it stays readable.

summary: The latte photo is unchanged and now has a clean, readable, warm 'Warm hugs in a cup' caption above the cup, with no obstruction and no extras.
